name: Mbed-TLS/mbedtls
description: A portable, easy-to-use TLS library and reference implementation of the PSA Cryptography API, designed for embedded systems with a footprint under 60KB. Supports X.509, TLS/DTLS, and a wide range of cipher suites.
score_rationale: Industry-standard embedded TLS library with 6.5k stars, reaching the major 4.0.0 milestone in October 2025 and actively maintained.
